name: Photonic Breath (Recharge 5–6)
description: The creature exhales a flashing mote of radiant energy that travels to a point the creature can see within 120 feet of itself, then blossoms into a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point. Each creature in the sphere must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
